query: Which priors and parameter ranges for multiscale concrete degradation (microcrack density, crack-length distributions, porosity, scatter properties) are most realistic for coda-wave simulation?

response.query: Which priors and parameter ranges for multiscale concrete degradation (microcrack density, crack-length distributions, porosity, scatter properties) are most realistic for coda-wave simulation?
response.answer: Priors for multiscale concrete degradation in coda-wave simulation include microcrack density around 0.1-0.5%, crack-length distributions typically between 0.1-1 mm, porosity around 5-15%, and scatter properties with standard deviations of 0.1-0.3. These ranges reflect realistic conditions for degraded concrete.
